comandi.fedora: sudo dnf install https://mirrors.rpmfusion.org/free/fedora/rpmfusion-free-release-$(rpm -E %fedora).noarch.rpm https://mirrors.rpmfusion.org/nonfree/fedora/rpmfusion-nonfree-release-$(rpm -E %fedora).noarch.rpm && sudo dnf install intel-media-driver mesa-va-drivers-freeworld   # Intel: intel-media-driver (nonfree); AMD: mesa-va-drivers-freeworld (free)
comandi.rhel: sudo dnf install https://mirrors.rpmfusion.org/free/el/rpmfusion-free-release-$(rpm -E %rhel).noarch.rpm https://mirrors.rpmfusion.org/nonfree/el/rpmfusion-nonfree-release-$(rpm -E %rhel).noarch.rpm && sudo dnf install intel-media-driver   # DOPO EPEL; solo Intel: su AMD la Mesa di RHEL è senza VA-API

comandi.tumbleweed: sudo zypper ar -cfp 90 https://ftp.gwdg.de/pub/linux/misc/packman/suse/openSUSE_Tumbleweed/ packman && sudo zypper --gpg-auto-import-keys refresh packman && sudo zypper install --from packman --allow-vendor-change Mesa-dri Mesa-libva   # solo AMD: il driver Intel ufficiale codifica già
comandi.leap16: sudo zypper ar -cfp 90 https://ftp.gwdg.de/pub/linux/misc/packman/suse/openSUSE_Leap_16.0/ packman && sudo zypper --gpg-auto-import-keys refresh packman && sudo zypper install --from packman --allow-vendor-change Mesa-dri Mesa-libva   # solo AMD: il driver Intel ufficiale codifica già

comandi.rhel: sudo dnf install epel-release && sudo dnf config-manager --set-enabled crb

comandi.fedora: sudo dnf config-manager setopt fedora-cisco-openh264.enabled=1 && sudo dnf install openh264
comandi.rhel:
printf '[epel-cisco-openh264]
name=Cisco OpenH264 per EPEL $releasever_major
metalink=https://mirrors.fedoraproject.org/metalink?repo=epel-cisco-openh264-$releasever_major&arch=$basearch
enabled=1
gpgcheck=1
gpgkey=file:///etc/pki/rpm-gpg/RPM-GPG-KEY-EPEL-10
' | sudo tee /etc/yum.repos.d/epel-cisco-openh264.repo && sudo dnf install openh264   # DOPO EPEL (la chiave è la sua)
comandi.tumbleweed: sudo zypper ar -f http://codecs.opensuse.org/openh264/openSUSE_Tumbleweed repo-openh264 && sudo zypper --gpg-auto-import-keys refresh repo-openh264 && sudo zypper install libopenh264-8
comandi.leap16: sudo zypper ar -f https://codecs.opensuse.org/openh264/openSUSE_Leap_16 repo-openh264 && sudo zypper --gpg-auto-import-keys refresh repo-openh264 && sudo zypper install libopenh264-8
